about_the_game:
Welcome to the Post-Apocalypse... Now What?

So, the nuclear war finally happened. Not because of ideology, resources, or territory, but for something far more… modern. An authoritarian leader invaded a neighboring nuclear power just to steal a factory of chips used in sex robots. We can’t even have a proper world war over serious reasons anymore?

Either way, you were one of the last to leave the bunker, and that’s when you noticed something was… off.
Someone decided to pull a dirty little prank: your precious jigsaw puzzles have been scattered all over the underground shelter, hidden by some anonymous trickster with a rather naughty sense of humor.

Now it’s up to you: explore the bunker, room by room, and recover every missing puzzle. Search under beds, inside rusty lockers, in dusty corners, and in all the suspicious places where a “comrade” with a filthy mind might have stashed something.

With each jigsaw you recover, you’ll unlock a brand-new spicy illustration to piece together. Rebuild your sweaty collection, one puzzle at a time, and reveal all the secret images.
Get ready for a cheeky, daring, and hilarious scavenger hunt like no other.

Features:

  • 200 Spicy Jigsaws to collect and assemble

  • 12 Interactive Environments inside a post-evacuation bunker

  • 3 Game Modes: choose between Hentai, Bara, or Futa with exclusive puzzles for each mode

  • 5 Puzzle Types for varied gameplay

  • Seamless Mode Switching via options menu

  • Play With One Hand

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains explicit nudity, consensual sexual content, and mature themes. Characters presented in many forms, such as monsters, angels, demons, cyborgs, and others. 

Sexual interactions occur between humans and non-human creatures, including monsters. Some characters appear in BDSM outfits and fetish gear. For mature audiences only.
